title: A box of rice, please!

before.predict: Look at the picture. Who is talking to the shopkeeper?

text.title: Ten minutes in Aziza's shop
paragraphs: Reporter: Good morning, Aziza. You work in this little shop. What do people buy every day?
Aziza: Good morning! Every day people buy **rice**, bread and oil. A big **box** of **rice** is very popular. My shop is small, but we have everything for a good dinner.
Reporter: How **much** **rice** is in one box?
Aziza: There are five **kilos** in one box. It is heavy, so I always help my **customers** **carry** it to the car. Many families buy one box every month.
Reporter: And how many **bottles** of water do you sell?
Aziza: About one hundred **bottles** every day! In summer we sell more. Children come here after school and they always want cold water and ice cream.
Reporter: Thank you, Aziza. Have a good day! Come again and bring your friends!
